test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)

question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution: The correct answer is **"temperature."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Temperature" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 5. • **"Temperature"** is a measure of the degree of heat present in a substance or object. (तापमान, टेंपरेचर) • **Example**: *Heat the oven to a temperature__ of 200°C.* • The correct answer is Option 4. • Correct passage: The average weather in a location over several years is __referred__ to as the climate. Climate change is characterised by a __shift__ in those average circumstances. The fast climate change we are presently witnessing is the result of humans' __usage__ of oil, gas, and coal in their homes, industry, and transportation. When these fossil fuels are __burned__, they emit greenhouse gases, mostly carbon dioxide (CO2). These gases capture the Sun's heat, raising the planet's __temperature__.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **'Humidity'** refers to the amount of moisture present in the air. (आर्द्रता, नमी, सीलन) • **'Pressure' **refers to the force exerted by a substance per unit area. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) दबाने या धकेलने से उत्‍पन्‍न शक्ति; दबाव) • **'Pollution'** refers to the presence or introduction into the environment of contaminants that cause harm or discomfort to living organisms. (वायु, नदियों आदि को प्रदूषित करने की प्रक्रिया; प्रदूषण) 1ce:T10e9, The correct answer is **"times."**
